name: Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - MARCH 14, 2013 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.
Approval of Registers of Demands
A.
City of Cerritos dated March 14, 2013. (COUNCIL)
approve the Register of Demands dated March 14, 2013 in the total amount of $2,381,508.10.
B.
Successor Agency dated March 14, 2013. (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the Register of Demands dated March 14, 2013 in the total amount of $71,000.00.
8.
Approval of the Treasurer's Report for the period ending January 31, 2013. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the Treasurer's report for the period ending January 31, 2013.
End of Consent Calendar
9.
New and Old Business
A.
Consideration and award of a contract for the construction of the Cerritos Library Teen Studio, Project No. 12117, Bid No. 1156-13. (COUNCIL)
award a contract in the amount of $290,141 for the Construction of the Cerritos Library Teen Studio, Project No. 12117, Bid No. 1156-13, to Dalke & Sons Construction and reject all other bids.
B.
Authorization for the City of Cerritos to execute a Renewable Energy Development Agreement with the Southern California Public Power Authority. (COUNCIL)
authorize the City Manager to execute the 2012 Phase II Renewable Development Agreement with the SCPPA (Attachment 1) for the purpose of investigating and developing potential new renewable resource options with an expenditure cap of $100,000 per project.
10.
Legislative Items
A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the State or Federal Legislature or pending in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.
1.
Review and consideration of proposed Federal Legislation S.1832 (Marketplace Fairness Act) and H.R.3179 (Marketplace Equity Act) to restore the State's Sovereign Rights to enforce State and local sales and use tax laws, and for other purposes. (COUNCIL)
1. Provide a letter in support of the efforts of the League of California Cities and California State Association of Counties in helping state and local governments recover taxes from remote sellers; and
2. Provide a letter to Congresswoman Sanchez advising of the potential economic benefits from S.1832 and H.R.3179 to the State of California and request support of legislation that will ensure that businesses remain competitive and cities and counties are equitably included in the collection of taxes from remote sellers.
2.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS TO OPPOSE SB 620 (WRIGHT) TO AMEND THE WATER REPLINISHMENT DISTRICT ACT AT WATER CODE §60000, ET SEQ. (COUNCIL)
1. Waive reading and adopt the resolution entitled: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS TO OPPOSE SB 620 (WRIGHT) TO AMEND THE WATER REPLENISHMENT DISTRICT ACT AT WATER CODE §60000, ET SEQ.
2. Direct staff to transmit copies of said resolution to Senator Wright, Assemblymember Garcia, Senator Ron Calderon, Senate Policy Committee reviewing SB 620, League of California Cities, California Contract Cities, Gateway Cities Council of Governments and Gonsalves & Sons.
11.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
12.
Adjournment
